text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I got a pimple...
Maybe it's because I stayed up late watching
"World Heritage Walks."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Proof of puberty! A badge of youth!
A single red spot is just maaarvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
...Still, it showed up in such a weird spot.
The more I look at it, the more it bothers me...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Right, if I hide my bangs like this...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ...I can't see what's in front of me, which is totally not marvelous! And pimples aren't marvelous at all either~!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Natureee~...!
Put my acne medicine on for me~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday found herself troubled
by rough skin.
